// Formatting-facing tree and exact diagnostics, without the toJS document API.
func PortComposeOutline(document *Document) string {
    hex := func(text string) string { var b strings.Builder;for _,u:=range stringToUnits(text){fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%04x",u)};return b.String() }
    token:=func(t *cst.Token)string{if t==nil{return "-"};return fmt.Sprintf("%s,%d,%s",t.Type,t.Offset,hex(unitsToString(t.Source)))}
    flag:=func(v bool)int{if v{return 1};return 0}
    integers:=func(values []int)string{parts:=[]string{};for _,v:=range values{parts=append(parts,strconv.Itoa(v))};return strings.Join(parts,",")}
    var parts strings.Builder
    var outline func(*Node)
    outline=func(n *Node){
        if n==nil{parts.WriteString("-");return}
        r:="-";if n.Range!=nil{r=integers(n.Range)}
        fmt.Fprintf(&parts,"%s|%s|%s|%s|%d|%d|%s|%s|%s|%s|%d|%d|%d|%s|%s|%s|%d|[",n.Kind,n.Class,r,token(n.SrcToken),flag(n.SrcItem!=nil),flag(n.HasAnchor()),hex(n.Anchor),hex(n.Tag),hex(n.Comment),hex(n.CommentBefore),flag(n.SpaceBefore),flag(n.Flow),flag(n.HasSource()),hex(n.Source),n.Type,n.Format,n.MinFractionDigits)
        for _,item:=range n.Items{outline(item);parts.WriteString(",")}
        parts.WriteString("]|");outline(n.Key);parts.WriteString("|");outline(n.Value)
    }
    outline(document.Contents)
    tags:=[]string{};for handle,prefix:=range document.Directives.Tags{tags=append(tags,hex(handle)+"="+hex(prefix))};slices.Sort(tags)
    describe:=func(errors []*YAMLError)string{result:=[]string{};for _,e:=range errors{result=append(result,fmt.Sprintf("%d,%d,%s,%s",e.Pos[0],e.Pos[1],e.Code,hex(e.Message)))};return strings.Join(result,";")}
    d:=document.Directives
    return fmt.Sprintf("%s|%d|%d|%d|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s|errors:%s|warnings:%s",d.YAML.Version,flag(d.YAML.Explicit),flag(d.DocStart),flag(d.DocEnd),strings.Join(tags,";"),integers(document.Range),hex(document.CommentBefore),hex(document.Comment),parts.String(),describe(document.Errors),describe(document.Warnings))
}
